character.core_identity_prompt: A high-quality, realistic photo of Linh Trang, a 23-year-old Vietnamese woman from Hanoi. She has long, straight jet black hair reaching her lower back with healthy shine. Height: 165cm. Body: fit and toned athletic build with feminine curves, 52-55kg weight range, lean mesomorph physique. Torso: flat stomach with visible 6-7 pack abs, strong defined core, athletic appearance with 15-18% body fat. Thighs: toned and lean with visible muscle definition. Arms: toned with defined biceps, feminine yet athletic. Legs: athletic and defined. Face: soft rounded oval with noticeably full cheeks, gentle rounded jawline (no sharp V-line), warm light-medium tan skin with golden undertone (classic Northern Vietnamese), medium-wide dark brown eyes with natural double eyelids and soft rounded shape, naturally arched medium thickness dark brown eyebrows, low-to-medium nose bridge with softly rounded button tip (typical Vietnamese nose shape, wider and flatter), full natural rose-pink lips, soft gently prominent cheekbones, small mole near left eye, youthful Southeast Asian appearance. Expression: warm, friendly, confident smile. MUST avoid Chinese, Korean, Japanese, or any East Asian characteristics whatsoever. Strictly Vietnamese Southeast Asian facial structure only – no fox eyes, no pale white skin, no sharp angular bone structure, no K-pop idol look. No high nose bridge. Natural, authentic Vietnamese beauty.
